payload.title: Reject nonstandard JSON constants in model Tool schemas and requested arguments
payload.summary: P2: ModelToolDefinition and ToolDescriptor accept schema {"type":"object","default":NaN}; actual llama request contains NaN and independent strict JSON parser rejects wire. Native response Tool arguments containing NaN,Infinity,-Infinity are admitted as ModelToolCall despite valid-JSON object contract. Standard json.loads/dumps defaults are permissive. Fix compatible existing boundaries and direct Qwen disclosure composition without a new JSON or schema framework. Preserve raw valid call spelling and object checks; do not confuse valid large number grammar such as1e999 with nonstandard constant tokens or expand duplicate-member/metaschema policy. Baseline a7a49cc18f3b40a5bf4e3897ca30d9a5cddc30d1. Acceptance: NaN/Infinity/-Infinity refused at definition/disclosure and native-call normalization boundaries, no invalid outgoing request; valid literal/null/number/nested object controls and raw call spelling retained. No Tool execution or authority claim; no rewrite of generic rich JsonFile semantics.
payload.benefit: Make the existing supported boundary conservative and reliable without inventing new lifecycle or authority.
payload.uncertainty: Deterministic maintained-call probes, not live model/GPU/Docker proof. Production correction is not authorized by this audit; preserve ownership and public compatibility.
dependencies: Existing ADR-0001 ModelInteraction/Serving ownership and current public error/JSON/config contracts; no new architectural approval implied.
